description: This file defines a UI component named 'NotesList' for a LightningJS application. It manages displaying, filtering, and creating notes, leveraging a NoteService for data operations. The component includes rendering templates, computed properties, methods for data handling, and input event handlers.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the NoteService and updates the display list.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query and updates the view.

methods.name: ensureOnSelect
methods.description: Ensures the onSelect callback is invoked with the currently focused item.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query state and applies the filter.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new note with a default title, refreshes the list, and triggers the onCreate callback.

methods.name: focusNext
methods.description: Moves the focus down the list.

methods.name: focusPrev
methods.description: Moves the focus up the list.

methods.name: $rowColor
methods.description: Determines the background color of a list row based on selection state.

methods.name: $rowAlpha
methods.description: Determines the opacity of a list row based on selection state.

methods.name: $time
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a human-readable 'Edited' timestamp.
